description: This Java class defines a custom application event called SearchCreatedEvent, which is triggered when a Hibernate Search object is created within the OpenMRS platform. It extends Spring's ApplicationEvent and is used to notify listeners about the creation of search-related entities.

classes.name: SearchCreatedEvent
classes.description: A custom application event in OpenMRS triggered upon creation of a Hibernate Search object, allowing listeners to react to search entity creation.

methods.name: SearchCreatedEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with a SearchAndEntityCollection object, passing it to the superclass ApplicationEvent.
